_source: Vision's own quote to IQ, by email, 22 September 2026. Euros, excluding VAT.
One price per model: a freehub does not change what a wheelset costs, so
all three of them take their model's figure.
These are here rather than read out of the Shopify export because the
export does not agree with them: every price in it is exactly 0.855 of the
quote — a 14.5% discount somebody applied on the way. Which of the two is
right is a question for Vision, and until it is answered the supplier's own
written quote is the one to buy against. rebuild.mjs reports the gap on
every run rather than quietly preferring one.
